# Fundamental Physics

This website contains a few simple and interesting mathematical results I found while reading the "The Theoretical Minimum" book series by Susskind and co-authors, "The Biggest Ideas in the Universe" book series by Sean M Carroll, and other sources that aim to simplify results from fundamental physics.
